notes: Indicators and the queue are computed by the figures layer (indicators.raise_indicators, judgement_queue, and a new case_judgement_queue that merges accounts by pence); summary.py only renders. Thresholds come from firm.load().thresholds_path (case root indicators.yaml by default) when that file exists, else the packaged file; a ThresholdsError or FirmConfigError is a refusal with no figures. The queue renders right after the case name, before the profile and every account's money-in breakdown; each account's indicators panel follows its monthly summary. Candidates are shown in the queue as well, though T21 completes R15 (policy panel).
